description: Deep token report: everything in /token/report (safety (honeypot, taxes, owner powers), holders (concentration, exchange/fund/locked share), liquidity (depth, locks, pools), price action, social/news buzz and smart-money signals (trade sizes, buy pressure, exchange and fund flows, whale transfers)) plus top 25 labelled holders, more transfer history, top traders when available, and an AI analyst verdict (stance, summary, risks, positives, what to watch). Price: $0.25 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). Paid only (not in the free trial). Try token-safety free first.

address.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint address.

chain.description: Blockchain: base, solana, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche.

name: token-report-deep

analysis.description: AI analyst verdict: stance, summary, key risks, positives, what to watch.

buzz.description: 0-100 buzz score, website and socials, paid DexScreener promotion and boosts, Hacker News mentions in 30 days.

holders.description: Holder count, top-1/top-10 concentration, sellable top-10, supply by kind (exchange, fund/market maker, pool, locked, contract, wallet), labelled top holders.

liquidity.description: Total USD, depth rating, locked %, liquidity/market cap, top pools.

liquidityKnown.description: False when only a price was available.

liquidityUsd.description: Total DEX liquidity across all pairs.

priceNative.description: Price in the pair's quote token.

priceAction.description: Price, % change 5m/1h/6h/24h, trend, volume and buys/sells per window, buy/sell ratio, volume/liquidity.

score.description: null when the contract scan or liquidity data was unavailable

smartMoney.description: Bias (bullish/bearish/neutral), signals, exchange, DEX and fund/market-maker flows, large transfers, top traders (when available).

summary.description: Overall rating (avoid, caution, ok, unknown), one-line headline, highlights and risks.

title: Token report deep ($0.25)
